name: Vigilant warden
note: Kestrel exosuit body pointing the advance, Spur sidearm raised, cloth tabard; integral keyed footplate.

name: Warden helm
note: Command helm: chevron split visor, keel crest with a crest blade, whip antenna; 1.6 mm D-flat peg.

name: Comms pack
note: Long-range comms pack: whip antenna with ball tip, dish housing, twin nozzles; 2.0 mm D-flat peg.

name: 25 mm base
note: 25 mm round deck-plate base: keyed recess for the footplate, 5 x 2 mm magnet pocket vented to the rim.
